sentence: This project studies how a protein in the extracellular matrix promotes atherosclerosis in humans and mice.
This project builds a learning system that explains its results, to help with cancer diagnosis and prediction.
This project studies how cells sense nutrients and control their growth.
This project uses multiple x-ray focal spots to make high-resolution, less noisy images with photon-counting CT.
This project tries to find out how force on proteins in cell adhesions turns into signals that affect cell proliferation and migration.
This project looks for biomarkers of colorectal cancer that predict how patients respond to treatment and immunotherapy.
This project tests a smartphone or tablet app that uses computer vision to detect early signs of autism in toddlers.
This project examines how deep learning applied to cardiovascular imaging can capture features of cardiac aging.
This project tests genome editing in mouse and large animal fetal models to treat diseases that strike before or soon after birth.
This project tests whether hybrid closed loop insulin pumps can help people with poorly controlled Type 1 diabetes manage their diabetes.
This project runs pilot projects that use patient navigation and social robots to address cancer health inequities in communities.
This project develops indicators and genetic circuits to report on and control cell signaling events non-invasively.
This project tests whether a signaling pathway is a weak point of tuft-like small cell lung cancer.
This project builds a genetically engineered mouse model of desmoplastic small round cell tumor to understand how the cancer develops.
This project uses machine learning to design images that match what a neuron prefers, to study how the brain works at a circuit level.
This project checks tissue from older adults with lumbar spinal stenosis for amyloid, to find transthyretin cardiac amyloidosis early.
This project studies how mutations in the blood are linked to cancer in exposed firefighters, using mouse models to confirm findings.
This project tries to find out how three genetic duplications raise the risk of strabismus.
This project studies how a full mix of hormones changes the states of motor circuits in the crab stomatogastric ganglion.
This project studies how neurons make and release a protein fragment that helps nearby cells survive stress.
